NoSQLServer v0.62 validation
============================

Focus
-----
1. Precise UTC timestamps in authoritative mutation journal records.
2. SQL UNION CORRESPONDING.

Journal timestamp contract
--------------------------
Every newly written mutation journal YAML now includes:
  timestamp: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ

The value is generated by ooRexx `.DateTime~new~utcIsoDate` at journal write
 time. INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE journal files are opened and verified by the
v0.62 smoke. Recovery-safe pending physical mutations also carry a timestamp;
if crash recovery must create the missing authoritative journal record later,
it preserves the original pending-mutation timestamp instead of inventing an
unrelated recovery-time value.

Example actually produced during validation:
  operation: INSERT
  generation: 1
  timestamp: 2026-08-18T13:29:16.910308Z
  changes:
    - after: {id: 10934, name: Diana Hopper}
      newPhysicalLine: 2

Capability:
  JOURNAL_UTC_TIMESTAMP

UNION CORRESPONDING
-------------------
Supports a top-level two-branch UNION CORRESPONDING. Output columns are the
caseless name intersection of the two branch projections, in left-branch
column order. Rows are normalized to that common shape and UNION distinct
semantics are then applied. ORDER BY is applied to the resulting common shape.

Hell Corpus v2 Q19 is independently oracle-backed. The expected result is the
five dept-10 employees (ids 1,2,3,4,9); the salary>90000 branch contributes ids
1 and 2, which are correctly deduplicated by UNION.

Capability:
  UNION_CORRESPONDING
